create_dataset_instance: create a Dataset instance with a base payoff matrix, training batch count, and value range
get_training_batch: get a training batch from the matrix dataset with optional random perturbation
get_eval_batch: get an evaluation batch from the matrix dataset with optional random perturbation
build_matrix_dataset: build a structured payoff matrix dataset for meta-CFR training and evaluation
test_dataset_perturbation: test the matrix dataset generates perturbed payoff matrices within min/max value bounds
